description: This file defines Sass mixins for visually hiding elements for accessibility purposes. It includes mixins to hide content visually while keeping it accessible, and to show content only when focused.

methods.name: visually-hidden
methods.description: A Sass mixin that visually hides elements while keeping them accessible to assistive technologies.

methods.name: visually-hidden-focusable
methods.description: A Sass mixin that makes content visible only when focused or when a child is focused, useful for skip links.
